Subject: Next steps to clear PO-48291 (entity residency docs)

Hi Maria —

Thanks for sending the invoice. Procurement has the PO staged (PO-48291) but we can't activate payment until we validate the vendor's tax residency documentation. Before we can remove the PO hold, we need the items below: 

1) A completed, signed W-8BEN-E (or W-9 if you are a U.S. entity) that matches the legal name on the invoice.
2) A short statement of tax residency (country of tax residence) and whether Acme Robotics claims any treaty benefits.
3) A beneficial ownership declaration (company-level) — a scanned signature is fine.

I noticed the invoice shows "Acme Robotics, Inc." while prior onboarding paperwork referenced "Acme Robotics Ltd." — can you confirm the exact legal entity and attach a copy of the business registration that matches the tax form? 

Attach any supporting docs to your reply (PDFs preferred). If your tax team prefers, we can send a DocuSign link.

Timeline: we need the completed docs by end of week to hit the vendor pay window next week.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the note — apologies for the name confusion. Acme Robotics is a Canadian corporation (Acme Robotics Ltd.). We are a foreign entity and are therefore providing a W-8BEN-E. Please find attached: 

- Acme_W-8BEN-E_signed.pdf (completed and signed)
- Acme_Invoice_7893.pdf (original invoice)

We are not claiming any treaty withholding benefits at this time. The legal name on the W-8BEN-E should be "Acme Robotics Ltd." — the invoice was created under the U.S. operational name by mistake. I can have our finance team reissue a corrected invoice if preferred.

Let me know if you need a company registration extract (we can provide a CRA business registration printout) or a beneficial ownership declaration.

Cheers,

- Please confirm the Canadian Business Number (BN) or equivalent tax ID and attach either a CRA registration page or a recent official utility/registry extract showing the BN and the legal name.

- Also, for our records, please complete and sign the attached beneficial ownership template (Im attaching a short stub form in the DocuSign link below). This is standard for onboarding non-US entities.

Marissa / Karthik — tagging you both to confirm whether the current W-8 files are acceptable for a PO lift once we get the corrected invoice and the CRA registration extract. If Finance needs any additional supporting evidence (e.g., Articles of Incorporation), flag here.
